comment: Fold cases (wave 028, run 0207, issue #65, decisions DEC-6 and DEC-8). Only Java reads this file: PlateauFoldServiceTest runs each case through the service and PlateauFoldCommandTest through `archicode plateau fold`; FoldTest builds its own data. A case copies the folder `base` of src/test/resources first, then writes `files` over the copy (a path from the workspace folder, the whole text of the file); `args` are the arguments after `plateau fold` (the service reads the plateau id, args[0], and ignores the options); a case with `scope: command` is run through the command only. `expect` is an `error` (the line the command prints on the error output, with `error: ` in front; exit 1, nothing on the standard output) or the `output` lines of the report (exit 0; an empty string is a blank line). The cases F09 to F12 of the TDD (an entry that names an element of the plateau below, a plateau no manifest declares, a patch that sets replaces, a fold into a plateau whose parent is the root) are hand-made data of FoldTest.

cases.what: unknown plateau: the sentence of the tree, unchanged

expect.error: error: unknown plateau `saaz`: the plateaus of this workspace are `baseline`, `inhouse`, `marketplace` and `saas`

cases.what: the root has nothing below it to fold into

expect.error: error: the plateau `baseline` is the root of the plateaus: nothing is below it to fold it into

cases.what: a leaf has no plateau above it

expect.error: error: the plateau `marketplace` is not overridden by any plateau, so there is no plateau above it to fold it into: to remove it, use Delete in the editor

cases.what: two plateaus that do not stack override it

files.inhouse-alt/plateau.yaml:
header:
  kind: "archicode.morin.io/plateau"
  version: "1"
content:
  id: "inhouse-alt"
  override: "inhouse"

expect.error: error: the plateau `inhouse` is overridden by `inhouse-alt` and `marketplace`, which do not stack: folding it into one would change the other. Keep it

files..archicode.yaml:
settings:
  name: "Brightcart"
  current: "inhouse"
  views:
    path: "views"
  facets:
    customs:
      - name: "journey"            # the purchase journey: no staff tools, no fulfilment
        actions:
          - operator: REMOVE
            json-path: "$.application..elements[?(@.id == 'agent' || @.id == 'merchandiser' || @.id == 'backoffice' || @.id == 'fulfilment')]"
      - name: "no-externals"       # what Brightcart builds, without its partners
        actions:
          - operator: REMOVE
            json-path: "$.application..elements[?(@.tags['rendering-stereotypes'] == 'external')]"
      - name: "without-cart"       # selects nothing in `saas`, where the cart is gone
        actions:
          - operator: REMOVE
            json-path: "$.application..elements[?(@.id == 'cart')]"
  manifests:
    paths: ["./**"]
styles:
  by-tags:
    external:
      background-color: "lightgray"
    legacy:
      line-style: 8
      line-gap: 4
    hot-path:
      line-color: "orangered"
      line-thickness: 3
  by-qualifiers:
    PostgreSQL:
      round-corner: 20

expect.error: error: `settings.current` names the plateau `inhouse`: write another plateau in `.archicode.yaml` first (`marketplace` is the one above it)

cases.what: steps of two stories name it, by at and by against

expect.error: error: the plateau `inhouse` is named by the story `fork_tour` (`shared/story.fork_tour.yaml`) step 3 (`at`), step 4 (`at`) and step 5 (`against`), and the story `seller_journey` (`shared/story.seller_journey.yaml`) step 3 (`against`): change those steps first, none is rewritten for you

cases.what: without --dry-run the command refuses (the command only: the service has no such option)

expect.error: error: plateau fold does not write yet: add `--dry-run` to read the plan

cases.what: the plan for inhouse into marketplace on the layered Brightcart, once the two stories that name inhouse are replaced
